hints.content: Therefore, we can set up equivalent proportions and solve for $k$.

$\dfrac{\red{k}}{\blue{4.5}} = \dfrac{\red{9}}{\blue{3}}$

 Note: As each corresponding $\dfrac{\red{\text{side}}}{\blue{\text{side}}}$ proportion is equivalent, you could use the other sides (i.e., $\dfrac{\red{k}}{\blue{4.5}} = \dfrac{\red{12}}{\blue{4}}$)

Reduce the proportion on the right hand side.

 $\dfrac{\red{k}}{\blue{4.5}} = \cancel{\dfrac{\red{9}}{\blue{3}}}{\green{3}}$

Multiply each side by $4.5$ and simplify.

 $\cancel{4.5} \times \dfrac{\red{k}}{\cancel{\blue{4.5}}} = \green{3} \times 4.5$
